product.name: Cambly English Tutoring Platform
product.description: An online platform providing English language tutoring through live video conversations with native speakers, available 24/7 for learners of all levels.

product.name: Cambly Small Groups
product.description: A service offering English practice in small groups with one tutor and one or two students, focusing on structured discussions for adult learners.

product.name: Cambly Private+ Subscription
product.description: A subscription plan granting full access to private and group English lessons, including lesson video replays and personalized exercises.

product.name: Cambly Kids Program
product.description: An English learning program for children aged 4 to 15, featuring one-on-one lessons with specialized tutors and interactive activities.

product.name: Cambly Tutor Community
product.description: A platform feature allowing individuals to join as tutors and earn income by providing English lessons on their own schedule.
